Proposal 6 is killed. Reed–Muller distance governs genuine codewords, not unrestricted signed pseudotables, and representing arbitrary assignments at the required degree permits point-supported extensions, defeating D-style spreading; the coefficient box is again externally imposed.

Proposal 7 survives only one finite geometric audit. It has no scalable way to impose exponentially many equal-radius constraints and no composition or dimension-gap law, but unlike G13 it does not require a common linear syndrome, so A does not already refute the bounded mechanism.
